'''Docking Bay 92''' was a [[Hangar/Legends|hangar]] located at the [[Betha II Starport]]. During the early [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]], a [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] team was scheduled to meet with the [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Cev Malanx]] at Docking Bay 92.
